interfaces.label: ST-Link
interfaces.desc: Programming and debug port (JTAG/SWD) of the backplane MCU, with UART.

interfaces.label: Payload port
interfaces.desc: VSYS, GND and the CAN bus for an external payload.

interfaces.label: External bus port
interfaces.desc: Breaks out the CAN bus with GND.

interfaces.label: HDRM
interfaces.desc: Two low-side switched VSYS outputs for the hold-down and release mechanisms.

interfaces.label: External charge port
interfaces.desc: Feeds the solar input rail from an external supply to charge the battery.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 1
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 2.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 2
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 3.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 3
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 4.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 4
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 5.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 5
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 6.

interfaces.label: Solar charge port 6
interfaces.desc: Solar panel input. Its current is measured by the power monitor of slot 7.

interfaces.label: Battery disconnect jumper
interfaces.desc: Pulls the DISQBAT pin of the battery charge controller to 3.3 V, which disconnects the battery.

interfaces.label: Standby jumper
interfaces.desc: Pulls the STBY pin of the battery charge controller to 3.3 V, which puts the charger in standby.
